queries_run: Eaton Corporation manufacturing footprint geopolitical risk China Mexico tariffs 2026
Eaton electrical equipment supply chain single point of failure switchgear transformer components
power transformer grain-oriented electrical steel GOES supply shortage China concentration 2026

findings.claim: Eaton's FY2025 Form 10-K discloses that the company relies on a global network of suppliers, contract manufacturers, transportation providers and labor markets, and identifies economic/political instability, government policy changes, increased tariffs, trade barriers and geopolitical conflict as risk factors affecting cost structure, sourcing, inventory and manufacturing-location decisions.
findings.source: Eaton Corp plc Form 10-K FY2025 (SEC EDGAR, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1551182/000155118226000007/etn-20251231.htm)

findings.claim: The U.S. power/distribution transformer industry (which Eaton participates in) faces an unprecedented supply-demand imbalance; a key structural bottleneck is grain-oriented electrical steel (GOES) — there is only one domestic U.S. GOES manufacturer, domestic GOES supply can meet only about 20% of U.S. transformer demand, and over 90% of high-grade GOES production capacity is concentrated in China, Japan and South Korea (China alone holds over 56% of global GOES production capacity).
findings.source: PowerMag 'Transformers in 2026: Shortage, Scramble, or Self-Inflicted Crisis?'; ChinaTalk 'Gridlocked: Transformer Shortage Choking U.S. Supply Chains'

findings.claim: China's exports of high-power transformers surged 61% year-on-year in January-February 2026 (exports to the U.S. up 182%), and Goldman Sachs raised its forecast for U.S. transformer import dependency to 60%, with transformer lead times extended from roughly 12 months historically to 48-60 months and manufacturer capacity effectively sold out through the end of the decade — indicating the U.S. transformer supply chain (Eaton's core Electrical segment input/output category) remains structurally dependent on a geographically concentrated (China-heavy) upstream steel and finished-transformer supply base.
findings.source: Futu News 'Global Transformer Shortage! China's exports surge 61%...'; ChinaTalk 'Gridlocked: Transformer Shortage Choking U.S. Supply Chains'

findings.claim: In response to the transformer/switchgear supply crunch, Eaton has invested more than $1.5 billion in global manufacturing capacity since 2023, including a specific $340 million investment to increase U.S. production of three-phase transformers, plus a new transformer manufacturing site in South Carolina and increased U.S.-made medium-voltage switchgear production, aimed at meeting data-center-driven demand and reducing reliance on constrained external transformer supply.
findings.source: RenewableEnergyWorld 'Eaton increases US-made medium-voltage switchgear production to help meet data center demand'; Eaton press release 'Eaton invests in new South Carolina transformer manufacturing site' (eaton.com)

geo_supply_chain.note: 查無 Eaton 自有工廠在台灣/中國生產基地占比或具體地理分布的量化揭露（10-K 只作一般性全球風險敘述，未列各國產能占比）；本軸證據以產業層結構性瓶頸（GOES 電磁鋼上游集中中日韓）與 Eaton 因應性資本支出為主，非公司自身廠址地緣曝險的直接量化。

queries_run: Eaton Electrical segment revenue growth 2026 data center megaproject backlog
Eaton Aerospace segment 2026 commercial OEM aftermarket growth backlog
Eaton Vehicle segment 2026 heavy-duty truck demand decline eMobility Dana spinoff

findings.claim: Eaton's Electrical segment (Americas + Global) delivered 13% organic / 20% total sales growth in Q1 2026 with ~23.4% segment margin; Electrical Americas organic sales grew 14% including roughly 50% growth in data-center-related sales, trailing-12-month order growth in Electrical Americas was up 42%, and total Electrical segment backlog reached $14.5 billion (up $4.4B / 44% YoY) with a rolling 12-month book-to-bill of 1.2. Data center orders were up roughly 240% YoY, with Eaton citing about 32 GW of U.S. data center capacity under construction (about 70% AI-related) and a 228 GW total data center backlog pipeline (~12 years of demand at 2025 build rates). Full-year 2026 total-company organic growth guidance was raised to a 9%-11% range.
findings.source: Eaton press release 'Eaton Reports Record First Quarter 2026 Results' (eaton.com/businesswire); The Globe and Mail 'Eaton Earnings Call Highlights Data Center Supercycle'

findings.claim: Eaton's Aerospace segment total backlog grew 28% year-over-year as of the end of Q2 2026, with a rolling twelve-month book-to-bill ratio of 1.2; organic sales growth in Q2 2026 and in the first six months of 2026 was driven by strength in commercial OEM, commercial aftermarket and military aftermarket.
findings.source: Eaton press release 'Eaton Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Results' (eaton.com/businesswire)

findings.claim: Eaton's Vehicle segment sales were down 9% and its eMobility segment down 15% in Q4 2025, underscoring persistently weak heavy-duty/commercial vehicle and EV-component demand; Bloomberg characterized Vehicle and eMobility as Eaton's 'two weakest units'. On 2026-01-26 Eaton announced plans to spin off its combined Mobility Group (Vehicle + eMobility), and subsequently agreed to combine the Mobility Group with Dana Incorporated via a Reverse Morris Trust structure, with separation/combination expected to complete by the end of Q1 2027.
findings.source: Bloomberg 'Eaton to Spin Off Its Two Weakest Units, Vehicle and eMobility' (2026-01-26); Eaton press release 'Eaton Advances 2030 Growth Strategy with Announcement to Combine Mobility Group with Dana' (eaton.com); CCJ Digital 'Eaton planning spin-off of Vehicle, eMobility segments'

end_markets.note: per_segment 已覆蓋 Electrical（Americas+Global，資料中心為主動能）、Aerospace（商用 OEM/售後市場）、Vehicle/eMobility（重卡/電動車零組件，已宣布拆分併入 Dana）三段；Electrical Global（非資料中心地區）子動能未單獨查得細節，惟未影響整體 per_segment 覆蓋判定。
